verdict.rationale: Visa documents a dedicated Intelligent Commerce Sandbox with self-serve sign-up and a Test Enterprise Business Center for sending test transactions. The Intelligent Commerce API has a separate test host (apitest.visaacceptance.com) distinct from production (api.visaacceptance.com), and the fees page states the product is free in Sandbox. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox working end to end, documented test data or test cards for agent token flows, and instant access (onboarding goes through an evaluation registration with instructions sent by email).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: After completing the evaluation registration process, you will be able to send test transactions
Free to use in Sandbox. Contact Visa for fees in Production.
